title: Exact super edge-magic total strength of a seven-cycle with four leaves at one vertex
scope: G(7;0,0,0,0,0,0,4) has an SEMT labeling with constant 26 (and sm=26 exactly by an ordinary degree-rearrangement bound), contradicting Deepthi Conjecture 1 sm(G(n;k_1..k_n)) = 2q+(n+3)/2 = 27 on its nonnegative leaf-count domain.
source_targets: Deepthi, arXiv:2212.05329v1 Conjecture 1.6 = Ars Combinatoria 159 (2024) 73-85 Conjecture 1
substantive_reason: Refutes a published universal strength formula in its stated family; the known Swaminathan-Jeyanthi bounds leave 26<=sm<=27 and the labeling attains 26.
novelty_standard: Qualified bounded comparison by root materiality ruling; reviewers held on unread older bodies
remaining_literature_limits: Swaminathan-Jeyanthi 2006/2003, Avadayappan et al. 2000/2001, Figueroa-Centeno et al. 2001 original bodies unread
trust_limits: Exact value 26 is ordinary mathematics, not the Lean endpoint
